The '''Fardon system''',<ref name="WbC" /> also known as the '''Soullex system''',<ref name="Despoilers">{{SW|url=news/the-imperial-warlords-despoilers-of-an-empire-part-3|series=The Imperial Warlords: Despoilers of an Empire|text=Part 3|nolive=1}}</ref> was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] known as [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Soullex]].<ref name="WbC" />
